concepts.name: session
concepts.definition: One supervised agent process (Claude Code, Codex, Grok or a custom CLI) that glimmervoid spawns in a PTY, keyed by a stable UUID and shown on the dashboard

concepts.name: worktree
concepts.definition: The git worktree glimmervoid creates for one session from the integration branch, so concurrent sessions never share a working tree

concepts.name: lane
concepts.definition: A background job glimmervoid runs beside operator sessions on its own schedule (team review, Radar, Visions, benchmarks, usage), built as a pure core, an IO-free poller and a thin wiring shell

concepts.name: view
concepts.definition: A primary dashboard surface the operator switches between (Focus, Board, Settings, Trace and the lane tabs), or one session's rendering inside it (Terminal, Conversation)

concepts.name: team
concepts.definition: The operator's GitHub team, whose open pull requests the team review lane reviews and lists in Reviews, Team

concepts.name: attention
concepts.definition: Which sessions need the operator now, ranked from their status, and the surfaces that show it (the Board attention row, the rail readout, notifications)

concepts.name: waiting
concepts.definition: The session status meaning the agent stopped and needs the operator, derived from hook events or the OSC-0 title

concepts.name: guardrails
concepts.definition: The protection each guarded session runs inside (sandbox-runtime plus Safety Net), meant to stop accidents, not a hostile agent

concepts.name: operator
concepts.definition: The one carbon unit who runs glimmervoid and its dashboard and answers its sessions

concepts.name: agent adapter
concepts.definition: The per-agent module (Claude Code, Codex, Grok, custom CLI) that tells glimmervoid how to spawn, resume and read the status of one agent kind

concepts.name: visions
concepts.definition: The editor lane that dispatches a model over the documents open in the VS Code extension and returns its comments and intent over LSP

concepts.name: radar
concepts.definition: The PostHog auto-fix lane that investigates PostHog errors in a session and writes an HTML report

concepts.name: operator config
concepts.definition: Glimmervoid's own settings file, config.json under the operator's glimmervoid home, whose shape is the config schema in shared/contracts/config.ts

concepts.name: monitoring
concepts.definition: The status the dashboard shows for a working session whose turn has ended while its background tasks or sub-agents are still running

concepts.name: starting
concepts.definition: The status the dashboard shows while a session sets up its worktree and boots its agent, until the agent's first turn begins

concepts.name: failed
concepts.definition: A session state: the agent process exited with an error, so the session needs the operator to restart or close it before it can continue.

concepts.name: zen
concepts.definition: A retired experimental dashboard view that showed each live session as a pet in a meadow and staged one session needing the operator at a time; past release notes still name it.

concepts.name: worth a look
concepts.definition: The review panel's short list of change signals an operator can act on: a file another session is changing, a package link into another repository, or a usual partner file left out.

concepts.name: committed
concepts.definition: Changes a session has recorded in commits on its branch, as opposed to edits still only in its worktree.

concepts.name: pairing
concepts.definition: Granting a device access to the remote listener with a single-use link from glimmervoid pair; a paired device has full control as the operator.

concepts.name: experimental
concepts.definition: A Glimmervoid build published from a green push to main as X.Y.Z-next.N under the npm next tag, and the settings that run only on such a build

concepts.name: channel
concepts.definition: The update stream an install follows: release (npm latest) or experimental (the newer of npm next and latest)

concepts.name: copy
concepts.definition: Text an agent or the operator puts on the browser clipboard from a terminal, offered through the Copy to clipboard prompt when the browser blocks the agent's own write.

concepts.name: rescan
concepts.definition: The first-run checklist action that looks again for installed agents and repository roots without a restart.

concepts.name: skip
concepts.definition: An operator choice to pass over a step Glimmervoid would otherwise take, as in skipping permission prompts or the skip-to-main link.

concepts.name: kimi code
concepts.definition: Moonshot's Kimi Code CLI, one of the agent CLIs glimmervoid supervises through its kimi agent adapter

concepts.name: question
concepts.definition: An agent's request for the operator's answer (Claude Code AskUserQuestion, Codex request_user_input, Kimi Code AskUserQuestion), carried as the question kind of a session's ConversationApproval and putting the session in waiting until answered

concepts.name: community question
concepts.definition: A question a member of the public asked on a watched community source (posthog.com/questions or an allowlisted Discord channel) that the Community tab tracks, researches and drafts a reply for, which the operator posts by hand.

concepts.name: discord
concepts.definition: A community source: the PostHog Discord server, read through the Discord events PostHog already captures, limited to the channel names the operator allowlists.
